blocks.text: Open a finalised invoice from the Invoices list. Press "Send" and confirm in the "Send Invoice" box. LanceraOS emails your client with the invoice PDF attached. The email goes from your own address if you set up "Custom Email" in Settings, otherwise from the LanceraOS address. You are copied on it.
You can do both steps at once: on the last stage of the invoice form, "Finalise & Send" finalises the invoice and emails it in one go.
If you sent the invoice yourself, for example by WhatsApp, press "Mark as Sent". That only records that you sent it. Nothing is emailed.
"Copy Invoice Link" in the More menu copies the page your client opens. "Resend Invoice" in the same menu sends it again.
The invoice PDF is fixed when you finalise. Changing your profile or business details afterwards does not change an invoice that is already finalised.
